assumptions: Boundary is the provisional overall-design-area polygon PROV-SITE-001; official polygon not yet published.
Area recomputed in CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E (EPSG:4548).
Green space includes the Jing-Zhang heritage park spine, Qing River interface and railway buffers proposed by the design; official green-line pending.
Public space covers plaza nodes at the three cores and station interfaces; additional public space may be realised through street sections and retained yards after official conditions are known.
Footprints are concept design carriers at the three key areas and corridor nodes; not a survey of existing buildings.
Total floor area, FAR, height and density remain unknown until official control conditions and building survey are available.
Land-use parcels tile the provisional site without gaps or overlaps; residual coverage gap below 40 sqm is within tolerance.
Design-proposed green ratio; the regulatory green ratio target is pending official control conditions.
Core plaza nodes only; linear public space embedded in street sections and park edges is not separately counted and will be re-measured with official geometry.
Three official key areas: zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area, beijing_ai_origin_community, dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster.

key_area_area_total_sqm.formula: sum(area of the three key-area provisional polygons) in EPSG:4548
assumptions: Provisional polygons matched to the announced 368.4 ha total within 3% tolerance; official key-area polygons pending.

scenario_card_count.formula: count(AI scenario cards in proposal body)
assumptions: At least 10 scenario cards required; 4 are AI industry test-and-validation scenarios.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(scenario cards flagged as industry test-and-validation)
assumptions: At least 3 industry test-and-validation scenarios required.

persona_count.formula: count(user persona profiles in proposal body)

assumptions: At least 3 AI pilgrimage landmarks required; all are concept landmarks, none approved or built.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package; must be confirmed against regulatory conditions before use.

building_height_m.reason: Approved height controls and aviation/heritage/landscape constraints are not in the public site package.

building_density.reason: Approved regulatory planning density conditions are not in the public site package.

setback_m.formula: official building setback from road redline / control line
setback_m.reason: Road redline and building control lines are not in the public site package.

total_floor_area_sqm.formula: sum(floor_area per building) = building_footprint_area_sqm x floors (official FAR not available)
total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Number of floors and FAR cannot be asserted without official control conditions and building survey.

ai_innovation_index.formula: composite index of patents, enterprises, talent, compute and open-source activity
ai_innovation_index.reason: Requires audited city-level statistics from official or cleared data sources; not yet registered.

talent_density_per_km2.reason: Requires population and employment census data that is not in the public site package.

public_space_renewal_projects.formula: count(renewal project list entries in proposal)
assumptions: Renewal project list covers the heritage park, Qing River interface, origin community, Da Zhong Si station, AI service nodes and the event route.
